title: How I Vibe Coded a $400K/mo App with Claude Code (Full Tutorial)
description:
CoinSnap makes $500K a month from one feature: take a photo of a coin, get its value. I rebuilt the same thing by vibe coding with Claude Code and zero coding experience, and in this video I walk you through the full build from UI design to testing on your phone. If you've been looking for a real AI app idea that generates recurring revenue in 2026, this one is worth your time.

🚀 Want more ideas? Join my FREE Newsletter: https://www.thebreadcrumb.co/

📄 Free App Publishing Resource Guide: https://pdhouse.notion.site/coin-app

Tools Mentioned:
Claude Code: https://claude.ai/code
Claude API: https://claude.com/pricing#api
React Native + Expo: https://expo.dev
Dribbble (design inspiration): https://dribbble.com
Acquire.com (sell your app): https://acquire.com
Flippa: https://flippa.com
CoinSnap (reference): https://app.sensortower.com/overview/com.coinidentifyer.ai?country=US

Timestamps:
00:00 - Intro
01:05 - Business Model
02:41 - Tools and Frameworks
04:51 - Claude Code Setup
08:07 - Building the App
12:41 - Building Functions
16:03 - App Testing
18:54 - Publishing to App Store
